blurb: Topfield Equestrian Center offers adaptive lessons, therapy services, and equine-assisted activities to empower humans through partnership with horses. Programs include adaptive driving, ground-based GRIT sessions for recovery and youth, and tours of the facility and herd. The center supports physical, emotional, and social benefits through horse interaction in a supportive environment.
